settings.evaluation_policy: One result per source class; no pooled score. Expected reference labels are remapped before category-aware evaluation. Target-class predictions whose best spatial reference (IoU >= 0.5) belongs to another source class are ignored for this cohort. Unmatched target-class predictions remain false positive candidates in each applicable cohort; their source colour cannot be inferred. Large orange references are excluded because their geometry differs; other/unknown references are also excluded.
